title: 'For future benefit of world': Trump 'cancels' planned Iran strike, subject to rapid deal
content:
• US President Donald Trump announced on Saturday the cancellation of a planned military attack on Iran.
• The cancellation is contingent on a rapid deal, which includes the immediate and total reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and an end to Iran's nuclear program.
• Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman (MBS) spoke to US President Donald Trump on Saturday, reportedly urging de-escalation of the situation.

title: US-Iran War Live Updates: Trump cancels planned attack on Iran, says 'perimeters of a deal has been agreed to'
content:
• US President Donald Trump on Sunday (India time) cancelled a planned attack on Iran, citing an agreed deal that includes the immediate reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and an end to Iran's nuclear threat.
• OPEC+ is expected to increase oil production by another 188,000 barrels per day for September, with members scheduled to meet on Sunday to extend output hikes.
• The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported two maritime security incidents off the coast of Oman, including one tanker suffering engine room damage after being struck by an unknown projectile.

title: Multiple people dead, injured in Twin Falls shooting in Idaho, video emerges; ‘suspect deceased’: Report
content:
• An "active shooter incident" occurred in Twin Falls, Idaho, at or near an In-N-Out Burger on Blue Lakes Boulevard North.
• Multiple people, including the shooter, were reported dead and at least two others injured in the Twin Falls, Idaho shooting.
• The In-N-Out Burger location, which was the scene of the incident in Twin Falls, Idaho, was the fourth in the state and had opened on July 24.

title: Trump hails Gaza peace deal as ‘great breakthrough’, but Hamas and Israel disagree on key conditions
content:
• US President Donald Trump described a newly announced Gaza peace agreement as a "great breakthrough" on Friday (July 31).
• The roadmap prepared by Trump's "Gaza Board of Peace" is a 15-point plan proposing the complete disarmament of Hamas, with heavy weapons to be stored under the supervision of the National Committee for the Administration of Gaza (NCAG), not transferred to Israel.
• Hamas signaled that the agreement's implementation depended on Israel fulfilling commitments made under the ceasefire agreement reached last year in Sharm el-Sheikh.

title: Top US General warns Pentagon he lacks enough naval forces to keep defending Israel from Iranian attacks: Report
content:
• During the past seven weeks of fighting, the US military has consumed large portions of its advanced missile inventory, including approximately 45% of its Precision Strike Missile (PrSM) inventory, at least 50% of its THAAD interceptor missiles, and around 50% of its Patriot interceptor missiles.
• Gen. Alexus Grynkewich, chief of US European Command (EUCOM), warned the Pentagon that the United States lacks sufficient naval assets to continue intercepting Iranian ballistic missile attacks on Israel.
• Replenishing many of the advanced US missile systems consumed in recent conflicts could take several years, creating a 'near-term risk' should another major conflict emerge in the coming years.

title: GST collections stay on track, rise 15% in July
content:
• Overall GST collections rose by 15% in July.
• GST collected on imports surged 28.8% to ₹66,511 crore in July.
• Net GST collections climbed 15.8% to ₹1.81 lakh crore in July.

title: RBI likely to hold repo rate at 5.25%, market to focus on policy guidance: Nuvama
content:
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is expected to keep the repo rate unchanged at 5.25% at the upcoming Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) meeting.
• The impact of GST rate cuts on economic activity is projected to fade in the second half of FY27.
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is likely to prioritize liquidity management over further rate action in the near term.

title: India's gross GST collections rise 15.4% to Rs 2.11 lakh crore in July
content:
• India's gross GST collections for July rose 15.4% to Rs 2.11 lakh crore.
• For the first four months of the current financial year (April-July), gross GST collections increased by 10.1% to Rs 8.43 lakh crore.
• After adjusting for refunds, net GST revenue for July stood at Rs 1.81 lakh crore, marking a 15.8% increase.

title: RBI's FCNR, forex schemes draw $40.81 billion in inflows so far
content:
• RBI's Foreign Currency Non Convertible Rupee (FCNR) and other forex schemes have collectively drawn total inflows of $40.81 billion so far.
• Foreign Currency Non Convertible Rupee Bank (FCNR(B)) deposits account for $36.72 billion of these inflows, surpassing the 2013 level of $26 billion, with the scheme operationalized on June 8.
• The cost hedging facility for these schemes is open until the end of September, while banks can raise External Commercial Borrowings (ECBs) and Overseas Foreign Currency Borrowings (OFCBs) until the end of the year.

title: Indian companies are about to raise prices, putting RBI's inflation outlook to test
content:
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) expects inflation to average 5.1% in the fiscal year ending March 2027.
• Consumer prices rose above the Reserve Bank of India’s 4% target for the first time in nearly a year and a half in June, though it remained within the central bank’s 2%-6% tolerance band.
• The RBI's six-member Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) is scheduled to meet from August 3-5 to assess inflation pressures.
